ranked_candidates.hidden_signal_to_verify: Verify customer verticals, robotics, medical, and defense automation exposure, design-win stickiness, backlog, margin quality, and whether AI or robotics demand is material.
ranked_candidates.main_evidence_gap: No provided source yet quantifies robotics-related revenue, customer concentration, specific high-growth programs, or whether motion-control products are difficult to substitute.
ranked_candidates.why_prioritized: Small-cap motion-control exposure fits the Serenity filter: it sits below the obvious robotics and automation demand layer, may be hidden by a broad industrial label, and has a clear verification path through customer verticals, design wins, backlog, margin quality, and robotics or medical or defense automation mix. The thesis remains a hypothesis because the provided evidence does not yet prove material AI or robotics demand exposure.
ranked_candidates.why_underfollowed: Allient may not screen as a clean robotics name even if motors, drives, and precision-motion components are embedded in automation systems. Its industrial-label ambiguity increases discovery value if the robotics and automation exposure proves material.

ranked_candidates.hidden_signal_to_verify: Verify program exposure, design-win duration, backlog quality, margin recovery, supply-chain constraints, and whether AI or edge-processing defense demand is material.
ranked_candidates.main_evidence_gap: The current evidence does not establish which programs are the key chokepoints, whether Mercury is sole-source or hard-to-replace, or whether recent margin issues are cyclical, operational, or structural.
ranked_candidates.why_prioritized: Mercury maps to defense-qualified electronics, rugged processing, RF, embedded computing, and mission systems, where qualification, security, and program duration can create supplier stickiness. It ranks highly because the demand durability of defense electronics and edge-processing modernization is plausible, and the thesis can be falsified through backlog, program exposure, margin recovery, and design-win evidence.
ranked_candidates.why_underfollowed: It sits below defense primes and outside the most obvious semiconductor and AI hardware screens, so any durable position in mission-critical processing or RF systems may be underappreciated by generalist high-tech supply-chain investors.

ranked_candidates.hidden_signal_to_verify: Verify robotics, machine-vision, laser, and precision-motion exposure; assess whether any product lines face supplier concentration or qualification bottlenecks.
ranked_candidates.main_evidence_gap: The provided evidence does not yet identify which Novanta product families are true constraints, how large robotics or machine-vision revenue is, or whether customer qualification creates pricing power.
ranked_candidates.why_prioritized: Novanta bridges precision motion, machine vision, photonics, and automation, making it a potentially relevant multi-node supplier for robotics, medical, and industrial high-tech systems. It ranks below smaller underfollowed names because the market-cap bucket is larger and the exposure may be diversified rather than pure.
ranked_candidates.why_underfollowed: It is often classified as diversified medical or industrial technology rather than as a robotics, photonics, or precision-motion bottleneck supplier.

ranked_candidates.hidden_signal_to_verify: Check segment mix, defense electronics content, platform positions, sole-source or qualified-source status, backlog, margin trajectory, and customer concentration.
ranked_candidates.main_evidence_gap: The evidence does not yet prove sole-source positions, electronics content materiality, or whether margins and backlog are improving because of chokepoint power rather than general aerospace recovery.
ranked_candidates.why_prioritized: Ducommun fits the underfollowed regulated-supply-chain lane: a small aerospace and defense supplier with potential electronics and structures content, where platform qualification and long program lives may produce stickiness. It ranks high because the thesis is obscure, testable, and not dependent on headline AI popularity.
ranked_candidates.why_underfollowed: Its mixed structures and electronics businesses obscure whether it is a true high-tech supply-chain bottleneck, and it is less visible than defense primes or large electronics suppliers.

ranked_candidates.hidden_signal_to_verify: Verify contract duration, certification barriers, part availability constraints, defense and commercial mix, acquisition integration, and whether supply scarcity improves pricing power.
ranked_candidates.main_evidence_gap: The current evidence does not show whether VSE controls scarce channels, benefits from regulated certification barriers, or simply participates in a competitive aftermarket cycle.
ranked_candidates.why_prioritized: VSE is a second-order supply-chain candidate where the chokepoint may be certified distribution, maintenance channels, parts availability, and fleet sustainment rather than component design. That indirect angle is attractive for underfollowed discovery, but public-market purity and evidence quality remain only moderate until contract and certification barriers are verified.
ranked_candidates.why_underfollowed: It is an aftermarket and sustainment business rather than an obvious high-tech hardware supplier, so screens focused on AI, defense primes, or semiconductors may miss the certified-supply-channel angle.

ranked_candidates.hidden_signal_to_verify: Verify exposure to datacenter power and networking, defense electronics, harsh-environment connectors, customer concentration, backlog, and margin sensitivity to component cycles.
ranked_candidates.main_evidence_gap: No provided evidence yet identifies a scarce product line, AI datacenter content, or defense-qualified component position with clear pricing power.
ranked_candidates.why_prioritized: Bel Fuse is a small-cap mixed electronic-components candidate with potential exposure to power products, connectors, magnetics, defense electronics, industrial electronics, and datacenter networking. It ranks as an attractive research lead because the signal is hidden and testable, but the bottleneck severity is not yet proven.
ranked_candidates.why_underfollowed: Its mixed component-company label can cause it to be overlooked by AI hardware, semiconductor, and defense-prime screens even if specific power or connector products become constrained.

ranked_candidates.hidden_signal_to_verify: Separate industrial robot reducer demand from broader machinery cycles; verify humanoid exposure, pricing, capacity, China competition, and robotics segment margins.
ranked_candidates.main_evidence_gap: The provided evidence does not prove humanoid or advanced-robotics exposure, current reducer tightness, or whether Chinese competition is pressuring pricing and margins.
ranked_candidates.why_prioritized: Nabtesco is a useful reference anchor for robotics precision reducers and industrial automation motion components. It scores well on demand durability and potential supplier scarcity, but lower on underfollowed discovery because it is already known within industrial automation and robotics supply chains.
ranked_candidates.why_underfollowed: It is less prominent than robot OEMs and AI names in physical-AI discussions, but it is not fully obscure within industrial automation.

Despite a high total score, it is not the primary underfollowed candidate because attention is already high and the thesis is closer to a visible photonics bottleneck leader than a hidden supply-chain discovery.

ranked_candidates.hidden_signal_to_verify: Separate AI datacenter optical revenue from telecom, industrial, materials, and legacy optical exposure; verify 800G and 1.6T, silicon photonics, CPO, and customer concentration.

ranked_candidates.why_prioritized: Coherent is a broad photonics and compound-semiconductor reference leader for optical communications, lasers, and materials. It is useful for validating where AI photonics demand is moving, but its breadth and high attention reduce public-market purity and discovery value.
ranked_candidates.why_underfollowed: Not underfollowed; included to contextualize smaller AI-photonics candidates and to benchmark laser, optical-component, and compound-material demand.

ranked_candidates.hidden_signal_to_verify: Benchmark advanced packaging, HBM, and AI accelerator process-control demand against smaller metrology and inspection suppliers.
ranked_candidates.main_evidence_gap: The evidence gap is not whether KLA is relevant to process control, but whether incremental AI advanced-packaging demand is mispriced relative to already high visibility.
ranked_candidates.why_prioritized: KLA is a reference benchmark for process control, inspection, and advanced-packaging metrology demand. It ranks last because it is a widely followed mega-cap reference leader, not an underfollowed discovery candidate, even though it is strategically important for benchmarking smaller metrology and inspection suppliers.
ranked_candidates.why_underfollowed: Not underfollowed; retained only as a process-control reference leader against which smaller inspection and metrology candidates can be compared.

summary: Layer 3 ranking for this chunk favors underfollowed, testable chokepoint candidates over popular reference leaders. The highest-priority research path is motion-control and qualification-constrained supply-chain exposure: Allient, Mercury Systems, Ducommun, Novanta, VSE, Bel Fuse, and Nabtesco. Photonics leaders Lumentum and Coherent remain important reference anchors for AI optical bottlenecks, but their higher attention and broader public-market recognition reduce underfollowed-discovery scores. KLA is retained only as a benchmarking reference for process-control and inspection demand, not as the primary alpha-hunt target in this chunk.
